_comment: Artifacts dotclaude once deployed into projects and no longer ships. scripts/prune-obsolete.py (run by init.sh/init.ps1 on every deploy) removes the matching hook entries from the project's .claude/settings*.json; mcpServers and files are only REPORTED, because deleting a server or a directory the user may still rely on is their call. 'match' is a substring of the hook command; each hook has a / and a \ entry so both the POSIX form and the PowerShell & "<abs>\name.ps1" form are caught. check.py fails if an entry names a hook or MCP fragment dotclaude still ships.

mcpServers.name: serena
mcpServers.reason: Serena was removed from dotclaude; the LSP plugin covers symbol navigation

mcpServers.name: graphify
mcpServers.reason: Graphify was removed from dotclaude; --codebase-memory is the optional code graph
